This PR introduces `beautifulsoup4` to handle HTML truncation instead of
implementing a custom truncation function.
Using BeautifulSoup avoids reinventing complex parsing logic and reduces
long-term maintenance risk.
It allows us to: 
Truncate based on text content while preserving valid HTML structure
Avoid edge cases around nested elements, inline tags, and mixed content

Attempt at creating custom truncation utility, required:
- Proper HTML parsing
- Handling nested tags correctly
- Ensuring valid output after truncation
- Maintaining and testing edge cases over time

The additional dependency with this change is small and widely adopted.
